_comment: Local tastytrade template. Copy to config.json. broker is the only place the broker is named, and tasty is this one's; no launcher, flag, or platform check sets it. tasty_orders=sandbox (the default) sends to api.cert.tastyworks.com. tasty_orders=production is real money and requires tasty_data=production. mode dry (the file's default) and alerts never send; mode live auto-approves and nothing waits on a human. There are no credentials here: the TASTYTRADE_* secrets stay in the environment or under secrets/. base_dir is left out, so SPX_NOON_HOME names the home directory.
_rules: Shared by both plans: 15m closes 12:00-1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop. Tastytrade does not chase a missed fill.
_plan: plan is the only trading rule that is a config key: B (the default, and what a missing key means) or A1. B: long nearest 75 delta, GTC close at debit x 1.30. A1: skip the day if any 15m close from 10:15 through 11:00 ET was already beyond the prior day's high or low, long nearest 80 delta, and exit at +8 SPX points in the trade direction or the 2-hour flat, whichever comes first - no premium target. Nothing else differs, and there is no PLAN environment variable.
_wrap: Read-only log summary: python -m spx_noon wrap. It does not connect and does not send orders.
